description: Slot generation, booking with double-booking prevention, cancellation, my-bookings, and confirmation email. The core value.

issues.title: Slot generation: free slots inside availability
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §5 rules, §7 GET /api/services/:id/slots. Pure domain logic — unit-testable without a DB.

## Task
Implement a `generateSlots(service, availability, existingAppointments, range)` function in `src/lib` and expose `GET /api/services/:id/slots?from&to`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Returns only slots fully inside an availability window for that weekday.
- [ ] Excludes slots overlapping any CONFIRMED appointment.
- [ ] Grid step defaults to 30 min; `endAt = startAt + durationMin`.
- [ ] Pure-function unit tests cover boundaries (edge of window, back-to-back).

issues.title: Create appointment with double-booking prevention (409)
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §8. This is the integrity-critical path.

## Task
Implement `POST /api/appointments` (customer only). Create the appointment inside a DB transaction with an overlap check so two concurrent requests cannot both take the same provider slot.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Booking a free slot returns 201 with a CONFIRMED appointment.
- [ ] A second booking of the same slot returns 409.
- [ ] Slot must be valid per slot generation (reject arbitrary times).
- [ ] Test simulates the concurrent/duplicate case and asserts exactly one wins.

issues.title: Cancel appointment (frees slot; blocked within 24h)
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §3.6, §8.

## Task
Implement `POST /api/appointments/:id/cancel` (owner only). Set status CANCELLED and free the slot; reject if start is within 24h.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Only the owning customer can cancel (403 otherwise).
- [ ] Cancelling frees the slot for others.
- [ ] Cancelling within 24h of start returns 403.
- [ ] Tests cover ownership + the 24h boundary.

issues.title: My bookings page + confirmation email
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §3.5, §6 /me/bookings, §7 GET /api/appointments/me.

## Task
Build `/me/bookings` (upcoming + past, with cancel) backed by `GET /api/appointments/me`, and send a confirmation email on booking (use a provider abstraction so the demo runs without real email).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Customer sees only their own appointments.
- [ ] Booking triggers a confirmation email via an injectable email sender.
- [ ] Email sender is faked in tests (assert it was called with the right data).
- [ ] No PII logged.
